reviewers.summary: The fixture-backed endpoint-flow test now uses the committed return-status.txt fixture. The client-registration test still does not detect credential construction, leaving the previously reported TRACE-PRODUCER-11 finding unresolved.

findingList.message: TRACE-PRODUCER-11 still does not prove that resolving IChatClient resolves no credential; the diagnostic-event assertion can pass when DefaultAzureCredential is constructed without emitting an event.

evidence.codePathTraced: Resolving IChatClient invokes the registration in Program.cs, which constructs a DefaultAzureCredential. The new assertion checks only Azure-Identity diagnostic events, which do not establish whether that credential object was constructed.
evidence.failureScenario: If resolving IChatClient constructs DefaultAzureCredential without requesting a token or emitting an Azure-Identity event, the event queue stays empty and this test passes despite resolving a credential.
